name: Callum Thompson
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical Psychologist working with adolescents and adults incl. neurodivergent individuals, anxiety, depression, trauma, substance use. Neurodiversity-affirming; draws on CBT, ACT, CFT and EMDR. Committed to a culturally safe, inclusive, and affirming space for all clients, including people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds and LGBTQIA+ communities.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, LGBTQIA+, neurodivergence, ADHD, autism, CFT

name: Kish Dayananda
title: Consultant Psychologist
description: Consultant psychologist, multilingual; uses ACT, CBT, DBT, IPT and Narrative Therapy. Treats depressive, anxiety and personality disorders, trauma, work and relationship stressors; works with first responders, defence and police. 'He is an LGBTIQ+ ally and values embracing neurodiversity.'
specialties: trauma, first responders, LGBTIQ+ ally, DBT, ACT, narrative therapy

name: Dr Stephanie Dias
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Supports people through anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship difficulties, life transitions, identity and self-esteem concerns. Draws on CBT, Mindfulness, ACT and Cognitive Processing Therapy (CPT) for trauma. Doctorate in Clinical Psychology.

name: Dr Anthony Smith
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical psychologist working with adults. 'Anthony also provides therapy related to sexual functioning and sexual health issues. He has a special interest in working with neurodiverse people, people living with a disability and working with LGBTQIA+ individuals.' Approaches include CBT, schema therapy and elements of DBT; also adult autism and cognitive assessments.
specialties: sexual health, sexual functioning, LGBTQIA+, schema therapy, neurodiversity, disability, adult autism assessment

name: Justin Teh
title: Psychologist
description: A gender and neurodiversity affirming psychologist. Uses ACT, CBT, DBT and mindfulness. 'Justin is passionate in supporting individuals within the LGBTQIA+ community and international students who experience anxiety, mood disorders, personality disorders, trauma' and cultural and interpersonal difficulties.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, gender affirming, trauma, international students, DBT, ACT

name: Dr Marcus Squirrell
title: Director & Clinical Psychologist
description: Clinical Psychologist with over 15 years' experience with adults. Trained in CBT, EMDR, ACT, Clinical Hypnotherapy, Sex therapy and medico-legal assessments. 'Marcus predominantly works with men and members of the LGBTIQ+ community' and provides WPATH Evaluations for members of the gender diverse community pursuing gender affirming treatment. Research interest in online sexual activity and men's use of anabolic steroids.
specialties: EMDR, sex therapy, LGBTIQ+, WPATH evaluations, gender diverse, men's health, hypnotherapy, addiction

name: Matt Borowik
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: 'Matt is an LGBTQI friendly Clinical Psychologist who works with both adults and adolescents.' Areas of expertise include depression, anxiety, LGBTQ issues, addiction, bipolar, borderline personality and schizophrenia. Works within an interpersonal and object relations framework, humanistic and mindfulness-grounded, using CBT where appropriate.
specialties: LGBTQ issues, addiction, borderline personality, object relations, CBT
